steps.arguments:
{"inp":{"code":"price = 29.4
LPA = 3.426704
VPA = 25.998294
EV_EBITDA_current = 6.362559
EV_EBIT_current = 6.781474
EBIT = 2.728561e9
Div_liq = 9.185367e9
# compute EV from EV/EBIT
EV = EV_EBIT_current * EBIT
# Compute EBITDA from EV and current EV/EBITDA
EBITDA = EV / EV_EBITDA_current
# Market cap = EV - NetDebt
market_cap = EV - Div_liq
# shares outstanding = market_cap / price
shares = market_cap / price
# compute target prices
# 1) P/L method: target_price_PL = target_PL * LPA (where target_PL = 14)
target_PL = 14.0
target_price_PL = target_PL * LPA
# 2) P/VP method: target_price_PVP = target_PVP * VPA (target_PVP = 1.4)
target_PVP = 1.4
target_price_PVP = target_PVP * VPA
# 3) EV/EBITDA method: target_EV_EBITDA = 8.5 => target_EV = target_EV_EBITDA * EBITDA
# target_price_EV = (target_EV - net_debt) / shares
target_EV_EBITDA = 8.5
target_EV = target_EV_EBITDA * EBITDA
# Note: shares must be >0
if shares <= 0:
    target_price_EV = None
else:
    target_price_EV = (target_EV - Div_liq) / shares
# Print results
print('EV (from EV/EBIT):', EV)
print('EBITDA (implied):', EBITDA)
print('Market cap (implied):', market_cap)
print('Shares (implied):', shares)
print('\nTarget price (P/L 14x):', target_price_PL)
print('Target price (P/VP 1.4x):', target_price_PVP)
print('Target price (EV/EBITDA 8.5x):', target_price_EV)
# Weighted price (40% PL / 20% P/VP / 40% EV/EBITDA)
weights = {'PL':0.4, 'PVP':0.2, 'EV':0.4}
weighted = weights['PL']*target_price_PL + weights['PVP']*target_price_PVP + weights['EV']*target_price_EV
print('\nWeighted target price (40/20/40):', weighted)
"}}
